auth.errTooManySignUp: Too many accounts were created from this network just now. Try again in an hour, or ask your organization’s admin to add you.

leave.courses: You will lose the organization’s own courses.
leave.again: You may be asked to sign in again.
leave.done: You left {org}. Your learning is still yours.
leave.signIn: You left {org}. Sign in again to carry on: your learning is with your account.

leave.lastAdmin: You are the organization’s only admin. Make someone else an admin first, then leave.
leave.notInOrg: You are not in an organization any more.

leave.disabled: This account is suspended, so it can’t leave the organization. Ask its admin.
leave.managedNote: Your organization manages this login, so you can’t leave it yourself. Its admin can remove you.
leave.unsent: Some of your work hasn’t reached Darsi yet. If you leave now, it stays on this phone and is sent the next time you sign in here. To send it first, connect to the internet and try again.
